```{python}
import requests
from requests.auth import HTTPBasicAuth
```

```{python}
ORIENTDB_HOST = 'http://localhost:2480'
ORIENTDB_USER = 'ROOT'
ORIENTDB_PASSWORD = 'fhdw'

authentication = HTTPBasicAuth(ORIENTDB_USER, ORIENTDB_PASSWORD)
```

```{python}
def repositories():
    url = 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories'

    params = {
        'q': 'stars:>0',
        'sort': 'stars',
        'order': 'desc',
        'per_page': 100
    }

    headers = {
        'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json',
        'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2026-03-10'
    }

    return requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers)
```

```{python}
def post(endpoint, body=None):
    return requests.post(f"{ORIENTDB_HOST}{endpoint}", auth=authentication, json=body)

def create_database(name):
    response = post(f"/database/{name}/plocal")
    if (response.status_code == 200):
        print(f"Database '{name}' created successfully.")
    elif (response.status_code == 409):
        print(response.json()['errors'][0]['content'])

def create_class(database, name):
    response = post(f"/class/{database}/{name}")
    if (response.status_code == 200):
        print(f"Class '{name}' created successfully.")
    elif (response.status_code == 500):
        print(response.json()['errors'][0]['content'])

def add_document(database, database_class, body):
    document = {
        "@class": database_class,
        **body
    }

    print(post(f"/document/{database}", document).json())
```

```{python}
create_database("github")
create_class("github", "repositories")
```

```{python}
repos = repositories().json()['items']
print(repos)

for repo in repos:
    add_document("github", "repositories", repo)
```
